questions.question: Three persons A, B and C had Rs. 360 altogether. A transferred half of the amount he had to B and C transferred half of the amount he had to A. After the transfer, all of them have equal amounts. What is the total amount B had before the transfer?
questions.solution:
Given,

Three persons A, B, and C had Rs. 360 altogether.

A transferred half of the amount he had to B and C transferred half of the amount he had to A.

After the transfer, all of them have equal amounts.

Therefore, A + B + C = 360 at the end they have 120 each.

Final amount of A = Final amount of B = Final amount of C = 120

Let 2y be the initial amount with C.

Then amount given by C to A = y

Final amount of C = 120 = inital amount of C - amount transferred to A = 2y - y = y

Therefore, y = 120.

Therefore, initial amount of C must be 240 and amount transferred to A = 120.

So, initially, A + B = 120 because A + B + C = 360.

Now, final amount of B = 120 and before transfer A + B = 120........ (I)

**Let 2x be the amount with A initially and z be the initial amount with B.**

Then 2x + z = 120. (from I) ..........(1)

Also, x + z = 120 (amount transferred by A + initial amount of B = final amount of B) .............(2)

From (1) and (2), we get 2x + z = x + z.

⇒ 2x = x

⇒ x = 0 and z = 120.

Hence, B had Rs. 120 initially.

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of numbers.

8 : 36
questions.solution:
Given,

8 : 36

The pattern followed here is,

8 : 36 = 8 × 4 + 4 = 36, here 8 is multiplied with 4 (half of 8) and addition of 4 to get number 36.

Similarly,

12 : 78 = **12 × 6 + 6 = 78,** her 12 is multiplied with 6 (half of 12) and addition of 6 to get number 78.

Hence, the correct answer is **12 : 78.**

 

**Note: **In the official question paper, option 4 was 10:42, but as it was generating multiple answers to the question, we have changed the option to 10: 43.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some students are listeners.

2. Some listeners are observers.

3. Many students are not observers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some students are observers.

II. Some observers are not students.

III. Some observers are listeners.

options.text: Only conclusion I and III follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8e50193376a0aa88e306df95acdef3f86aade81a409ab24b2ef66b0a2ff2b90.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some students are observers → False (It is possible but not definite)

II. Some observers are not students → False (It is possible but not definite)

III. Some observers are listeners → True (From Venn diagram we see it is possible)

Hence, the correct answer is** Only conclusion III follows.**

questions.question:
How many triangles are present in the following figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbad50acdff15e3502c161289d04427167ac3ee5081b019c8ff60dfec976fb28.png]
questions.solution:
Given,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbad50acdff15e3502c161289d04427167ac3ee5081b019c8ff60dfec976fb28.png] 

The number of triangles is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77f041bdfe818fca195328c79a368372574155a44190a18f4aafa13c815797b2.png] 

Here we see small triangles are 6 × 2 = 12

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb101d21a92bd318739e07c35fdc2c2ad21906022c7a9016a7a2c1e565bd3b0a.png] 

Triangles formed by combining small triangles = 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22ebbf671598abea96036feeffcd621cec2fe7e22693f45b1dc142fdb4515179.png] 

Large triangles = 2

Total triangles = 12 + 2 + 2 = 16

Hence, the correct answer is **16.**
